name: Maruti Suzuki
title: Maruti Suzuki India Limited Financial Results Q2 and H1 FY 2026-27

read.thesis: Record Q2 volume of 696,654 units (+26.5%) with network inventory at about 17 days and ~200,000 pending bookings, but EBIT fell to INR 28,037 mn from INR 33,820 mn on commodity costs.

utilisation.quote: Recent capacity additions have enabled the Company to serve the strong demand.
